schema.description: Always "ipkit.v1" so clients can detect breaking changes.

ip.description: The public address that was detected (current connection) or requested (lookup).

source.description: "ipregistry" when the configured intelligence provider succeeded; "cloudflare" when the record is built from Cloudflare edge metadata only.

location.description: Geolocation fields (continent, country, countryCode, region, regionCode, city, postalCode, latitude, longitude, timezone).

network.description: Network fields (asn, organization, domain, route, usage, carrier).

security.description: Security flags (proxy, vpn, tor, relay, cloud, threat, risk).
